# doc-keeper (ellmos-doc-keeper) — LLM Entry Point

> Deterministic 3-Cause Documentation Audit & Decision Rule Router for Ocean, BACH, and arbitrary Git repositories.

- Package: `ellmos-doc-keeper`
- Version: `0.1.0`
- License: `MIT`
- Language / Runtime: Python `>=3.10` (zero third-party runtime dependencies; stdlib only)
- Repository: `https://github.com/ellmos-ai/doc-keeper`
- Product Skill: `SKILL.md`
- Bilingual Docs: `README.md` (EN), `README_de.md` (DE)
- Agent Role Prompts: `prompts/DOC-KEEPER.en.md`, `prompts/DOC-KEEPER.de.md`
- Module Manifest: `ellmos-module.v2.json`
- Rule Config: `config/doc_machine.config.json`
- Last-checked: `2026-11-22`

## 1. Prerequisites
- Python `>=3.10`
- Optional: `git` on `PATH` (used read-only for `git log -S` erosion checks)
- Network egress: `none` (100% local static AST & filesystem inspection)

## 2. Installation Command
```bash
python -m venv .venv
.venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -e .
```
(On Linux/macOS use `.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e .`)

## 3. Verification Command
```bash
python -m doc_keeper --help
python -m doc_keeper audit . --json
python -m pytest -ra -v
```

## 4. Minimal Example
```bash
python -m doc_keeper audit /path/to/repo --json
python -m doc_keeper rules /path/to/repo
```

```python
from doc_keeper import audit_repository

report = audit_repository(".")
print(report["summary"])
```

## Core Interfaces
- CLI (`src/doc_keeper/cli.py`):
  - `doc-keeper audit [repo] [--json] [--output PATH]`
  - `doc-keeper rules [repo]`
- Python API (`src/doc_keeper/__init__.py`):
  - `extract_repo_claims(repo_root, doc_globs=...)`
  - `audit_repository(repo_root, doc_globs=..., config_override=...)`
  - `classify_doc_reality_diff(...)`
  - `resolve_doc_machine_dispatch(...)`
  - `load_doc_machine_config(workspace_root=..., config_override=...)`
